verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ACH transfer origination via POST /ach_transfers, approval holds, and webhooks for real-time events, showing the core API-first-class credit path with async notifications. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of debit-side ACH, same-day ACH windows, or return/NOC/reversal objects as first-class API entities with webhooks, which are central to the story. missing for 10: same-day ACH window support, explicit ACH debit examples, return/NOC/reversal object modeling and their webhook events.
